opening_rules.CLOSED: C>=0.75 -> OPENING with open_counter=1; otherwise CLOSED and reset counters
opening_rules.OPENING: C>=0.75 -> increment open_counter; when counter>=3 -> OPEN; otherwise remain OPENING; C<0.75 -> CLOSED and reset
opening_rules.OPEN: C<=0.55 -> CLOSING with close_counter=1; otherwise remain OPEN
opening_rules.CLOSING: C<=0.55 -> increment close_counter; when counter>=2 -> CLOSED; C>0.55 -> OPEN and reset close counter
opening_rules.safety_override: invalid/stale/ineligible/data-invalid forces CLOSED, aperture=0, counters reset, candidate invalidated

conditions.condition: valid ReturnShape and finite bounded score inputs
consecutive open qualification count to OPEN

furthest_condition_from_satisfaction: C opening qualification; all safety/hard/gate conditions passed and counters never started
additional_requirements_beyond_one_C_ge_: two further consecutive C>=0.75 evaluations are required to reach counter 3 and OPEN

candidate_creation.rule: after hysteresis, current_state == OPEN and current_candidate is null
candidate_creation.reachability: same as reaching OPEN plus no existing candidate
